candidates.change_summary: Credit the caller instead of the beneficiary so imBalances changes at the wrong key.
Accumulate the raw mAssetAmount as credits rather than the issued credits, changing the imBalances value.
Remove the imBalances update so the beneficiary's balance never increases.
Insert a duplicate imBalances increment so the beneficiary's balance is credited twice.
Approve a fixed amount (1e18) instead of type(uint256).max, changing the resulting allowance observable via savings.allowance.
Approve msg.sender instead of the savings contract, changing the spender whose allowance is set.
Delete the safeApprove call so no allowance is granted at all.
Use tx.origin instead of msg.sender in the owner check, changing which callers may execute approveMax (observable via revert for EOA-initiated calls by the owner through a contract).
